claim.quote: This observation provides the strongest direct detection constraint to date on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering for WIMP masses $>20$ GeV/c$^{2}$.

key_value.note: Effective exposure of the Fermilab run; three candidate events were consistent with a neutron background.

name: Improved Limits on Spin-Dependent WIMP-Proton Interactions from a Two Liter CF$_3$I Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: A 3.5-kg bubble chamber of superheated CF3I in the MINOS tunnel at Fermilab saw three candidate events, consistent with neutrons, and set the strongest limit then on spin-dependent WIMP-proton scattering for heavier WIMPs.
summary.technical: 3.5 kg CF3I, 19 August-18 December 2009, MINOS near-detector tunnel (300 ft overburden); acoustic alpha/nuclear-recoil discrimination; three dark matter candidate events in an effective exposure of 28.1 kg-day, consistent with a neutron background; limit for WIMP masses above 20 GeV/c^2 (Phys. Rev. Lett. 106, 021303).

title: Improved Limits on Spin-Dependent WIMP-Proton Interactions from a Two Liter CF$_3$I Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract states it as the strongest direct-detection constraint to date on WIMP-proton spin-dependent scattering for masses above 20 GeV/c^2.
